reasons: ES2660 is a must-take course but has no prerequisites and is offered in Sem 1 and Sem 2. It can be taken in Sem 5, 6, 7, or 8.
CS3103 is offered only in Sem 1 (odd semesters). It requires CS2105. CS2105 requires CS2040S (completed). So CS3103 can be taken in Sem 5 or 7.

CS4223 requires (CS2106 or CG2271) AND (CS3210 or CS3220 or CG3207). CS2106 is in the must-take list. CS3210 requires CS2100 (completed). CS3220 is not offered. CG3207 requires EE2026 and (CG2028 or EE2028). The student has not completed EE2026, CG2028, or EE2028. These are not in the must-take list. Therefore, the prerequisite for CS4223 cannot be met with the given must-take courses alone.

Since CS4223 is a must-take and its prerequisites cannot be satisfied by the completed courses or the other must-take courses (which do not include the necessary architecture/electronics courses), no valid plan exists.
